skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Develop and apply fundamental programming concepts and techniques in Java, including object-oriented programming, exception handling, and multithreading.
Analyze and solve complex problems using Java programming.
Collaborate effectively in a team to complete projects and presentations.
Demonstrate the ability to learn independently and manage personal projects.
Apply critical thinking to evaluate and improve software quality.
Effectively communicate technical concepts and solutions to peers and instructors.
Manage and deliver software projects within specified timelines.
Design, develop, test, and deploy software applications using Java.
Implement object-oriented design principles in Java.
Develop concurrent applications using Java multithreading.
Handle errors and exceptions effectively in Java applications.
Use data structures and algorithms in Java.
Create user interfaces using Java libraries.
Perform software testing and quality assurance.
Utilize Java 8's Lambda expressions and Stream API.
